messages.description: Provides a standalone MQTT broker (server) for arbitrary MQTT clients. Connected devices create their own states below mqttbroker://<instance>/<topic>; states that are no longer updated are removed automatically after a configurable idle retention time. Optionally the complete homeESS state tree is exposed below states/, honouring the stored write permissions.
messages.states_hint: States appear automatically as soon as a client publishes to a topic. Without an update within the idle retention time they are removed again.
messages.confirm_clear: Remove all device states of this instance?
messages.browser_failed: The topic list could not be loaded.
messages.browser_hint: The homeESS grouping mirrors the state tree, the MQTT grouping follows the topic path. Either way the copy button puts the complete MQTT path on the clipboard — for directories of the MQTT grouping the matching subscription filter ending in “/#”.
messages.browser_system_hint: The states/ system tree only appears once system-wide state access is enabled in the instance settings.
